title: Singularity News :: CCG
why_read: A Halloween-themed hackathon submission building a card game, offering minimal technical substance for a professional digest.
analysis: This is a Hacktoberfest challenge submission describing a browser-based collectible card game built with CSS-based 3D rendering and a no-build, pure-HTML development approach, deployed as a PWA. The write-up is heavily stylized with in-character 'lore' framing rather than technical explanation, making it hard to extract concrete engineering lessons. While the no-build PWA approach is mildly interesting, the post reads more like a playful submission than substantive technical content. Low value for engineers seeking real technical takeaways.
